definition.simple: An agreement, traded on an exchange, to buy or sell something at a set price on a set future date.
definition.balanced: A standardised contract whose rules are set in its specification: [[contract-size]] or [[multiplier]], [[tick-size]], [[contract-month|contract months]], [[expiry]] and settlement method. Buyers and sellers put down [[margin]], and gains and losses are settled daily through [[mark-to-market]]. Every contract has its own specification.

example: Example index future (fictional specs): multiplier 10 USD per point, tick size 0.25, cash-settled.
